description: This PHP source file defines a REST API endpoint class `ValidationProjectActivityNameAPI` within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. The class provides an API method to validate the uniqueness of a project activity name, supporting GET requests to check if an activity name is already taken for a specific project and activity ID. It includes request parameter validation, access to project and activity DAOs, and constructs a result indicating whether the activity name can be changed (i.e., if it's available). The class uses traits and extends a base Endpoint class, following a defined API structure with documented OpenAPI annotations.

classes.name: ValidationProjectActivityNameAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for validating project activity name uniqueness within the OrangeHRM Time plugin. Handles GET requests to check if an activity name is available for a given project and activity ID, ensuring proper validation and response formatting.

methods.description: Handles GET requests to validate if a project activity name is unique, by checking against the project and activity data, and returns a boolean indicating if the activity name can be changed (not already taken).
